notice: Simulation only. Not authorised for flight.

provenance.title: Chandigarh synthetic golden run: two hubs, eight nodes, corridor contention

weather.source: synthetic frozen trace (no live fetch during a deterministic run)

provenance.corridor_label: Synthetic corridor model (planning heuristic only, not a clearance assessment)

corridor_summary.note: Derived from road and green-space alignment only, as a visual and planning heuristic. A drone is not safer for flying above a road: wires, traffic, trees and rooftops still apply, and this dataset has no vertical measurement for any of them.
what_this_does_not_prove: that any corridor has obstacle clearance
that any corridor is permitted, or legal, or surveyed
that flying above a road reduces risk
that the wires crossing these roads are anywhere near the assumed height

provenance.what_this_does_not_prove: Nothing about real Chandigarh airspace, aircraft performance, weather or certification. Geometry is synthetic and obstacle heights in the wider dataset require survey.

basemap.label: Basemap: synthetic region mask, no live tiles

polygons.label: Modelled keep-out around a fictional airfield pad - NOT official airspace data
polygons.basis: demo input: fixed radius, no survey, no NOTAM, no publication
